description: Registers an existing and disabled user, group, or resource for WorkMail use by associating a mailbox and calendaring capabilities.

incidents.description: Threat Actors Using AWS WorkMail in Phishing Campaigns

securityImplications: Attackers might use RegisterToWorkMail to give a WorkMail user a mailbox, so it can immediately send email to external recipients through the web client or SMTP.

simulation.value: aws workmail register-to-work-mail --organization-id m-11111111111111111111111111111111 --entity-id TrailDiscoverUserId --email traildiscover@traildiscover.example.com
